title: WebView command-boundary audit
summary: Add a generated WebView command-boundary audit that verifies action controls, API route ownership, and frontend no-mutation guardrails.
reason: The promoted WebView surface needs durable evidence that every mutation-capable action remains backend-owned and does not locally implement filesystem, settings, queue, rename, publish/drain, or media-policy behavior.

behavior_after: A generated command-boundary audit reports classified WebView controls, backend-owned API route usage, high-risk route confirmations, and forbidden frontend mutation API scans, with focused tests and WebView prework coverage.

rollback_plan: Remove the WebView command-boundary audit script, generated audit JSON, package script wiring, focused unittest, docs coverage notes, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes:
No Local API routes, backend command behavior, media policy, FFmpeg/subtitle/audio logic, publish/drain behavior, rename apply behavior, settings persistence semantics, or source/scratch/output movement are changed.
